data.body_html:
Imagine gliding across the sparkling Mediterranean, a glass of cava in hand, as wild dolphins leap alongside your private yacht. That's the reality of a Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2031. Departing from the glamorous Puerto Banús, this 2-hour experience combines wildlife spotting with a luxurious brunch, all for €749 for up to 9 or 11 guests. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply craving a unique day out, this cruise delivers unforgettable moments on the Costa del Sol.

Our fleet includes the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), both fully equipped for dolphin watching. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish IVA, and a brunch spread with drinks. Read on for everything you need to know about booking your 2031 dolphin watching brunch cruise in Marbella.

Why Choose a Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline is a prime location for dolphin sightings, thanks to the nutrient-rich waters of the Alboran Sea. From May to October, common dolphins, striped dolphins, and even bottlenose dolphins are frequently spotted just a few nautical miles from shore. A brunch cruise adds a gourmet touch: expect fresh pastries, fruit, cheeses, and a selection of drinks including beer, white wine, cava, and soft drinks. The 2-hour format is perfect for families, couples, or small groups who want a taste of luxury without a full-day commitment.

What's Included in Your 2-Hour Cruise?

Your €749 booking covers everything you need for a seamless experience:

  • Licensed skipper and crew
  • Fuel and all operating costs
  • Brunch: light snacks, pastries, fruit, and cheese platter
  • Drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% tax)

No hidden fees, no extras. Just show up at Puerto Banús and step aboard.

Which Boats Are Available for Dolphin Watching?

We offer two primary vessels for this experience, both departing from Puerto Banús:

BoatLengthMax PassengersPrice (2h)
Astondoa 4012.5m9€749
Azimut 3912.5m11€749

Both boats are well-maintained, comfortable, and equipped with shaded areas, sun pads, and a sound system. For larger groups, consider upgrading to an 8-hour charter on a larger vessel like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – browse our full fleet for options.

Best Time for Dolphin Sightings in Marbella

The peak season for dolphin watching is May through October, when waters are warm and marine life is abundant. Morning cruises (10:00–12:00) offer the calmest seas and best light for photography. Afternoon cruises are available on request and can be paired with a sunset view over La Concha mountain. While sightings are common (over 90% success rate in season), we offer a complimentary reschedule if no dolphins are seen.

How to Book Your Marbella Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise 2031

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for your preferred date and boat. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance, especially during summer months. Your €749 fee covers the entire charter – you're not paying per person, so bring your group of up to 9 or 11 guests and split the cost. For longer cruises (4h, 6h, or 8h), pricing is available on request.

Explore other Marbella boat rental experiences including sunset cruises, fishing trips, and full-day charters.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in the Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise?

The cruise includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (brunch style), insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You only need to bring yourself and your group.

How long does the dolphin watching brunch cruise last?

The standard duration is 2 hours, priced at €749 for boats like the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Longer charters (up to 8 hours) are available on request.

What type of dolphins can we see in Marbella?

Common species include common dolphins, striped dolphins, and occasionally bottlenose dolphins. The Alboran Sea is a rich feeding ground, so sightings are frequent, especially from May to October.

Where does the cruise depart from?

All our dolphin watching brunch cruises depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. You'll meet the boat at the dock, and we'll confirm the exact berth upon booking.

Can we bring children on the dolphin watching cruise?

Yes, children are welcome. Our boats are family-friendly, with safety equipment for all ages. The brunch includes kid-friendly snacks and drinks. Just let us know when booking.

What happens if we don't see any dolphins?

While sightings are very common (over 90% success rate in season), we cannot guarantee wildlife. If no dolphins are seen, we offer a complimentary second trip on another day, subject to availability.

Is the brunch suitable for dietary restrictions?

We can accommodate vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free requests with advance notice. Please inform us when booking via WhatsApp, and we'll tailor the brunch accordingly.

What is the best time of day for the cruise?

Morning cruises (10:00–12:00) are ideal for dolphin activity and calm seas. The light is also best for photos. Afternoon options are available on request.
